Make a PDF from images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC), one per page. Pasar fotos a PDF.
Page size A4, Letter or fit; margin; photo orientation is honoured. A folder means all its images in name order.
Sinónimos: pasa estas fotos a pdf, junta las imágenes en un pdf, escaneos a pdf, hazme un pdf con estas capturas

output.description: Absolute path of the result file. Default: next to the source with a suffix, or in the workshop folder for stored documents.
output.title: Output

out_dir.description: Absolute folder for the result instead of the default one.
out_dir.title: Out Dir

file_result.description: Also file each resulting PDF in Kafka as a new document and return its id (doc_ids).
file_result.title: File Result

images.description: Images in page order: absolute paths, document ids or a folder (its images, in natural name order).
images.title: Images

page_size.description: Page size, or fit: each page takes its image's size.
page_size.title: Page Size

margin_mm.description: Margin around each image in millimetres.
margin_mm.title: Margin Mm

schema.name: pdf_from_office
schema.description:
Convert Word, ODT or RTF documents to PDF (Word or LibreOffice). Convertir un Word a PDF.
Uses Microsoft Word on Windows when installed, otherwise LibreOffice; says clearly when neither exists. Writes «<name>.pdf» next to the source.
Sinónimos: convierte el word a pdf, pasa el docx a pdf, guarda el documento como pdf, de doc a pdf

output.description: Absolute path of the result file. Default: next to the source with a suffix, or in the workshop folder for stored documents.
output.title: Output

out_dir.description: Absolute folder for the result instead of the default one.
out_dir.title: Out Dir

file_result.description: Also file each resulting PDF in Kafka as a new document and return its id (doc_ids).
file_result.title: File Result

file.description: A .docx, .doc, .odt or .rtf file: absolute path or document id (d_…).
file.title: File

engine.description: auto: Word on Windows when installed, else LibreOffice.
engine.title: Engine

schema.name: pdf_to_images
schema.description:
Render PDF pages as PNG or JPG images. Pasar páginas de un PDF a imágenes.
Writes into a new folder «<name>_imagenes». dpi 36-600 (default 150).
Sinónimos: pdf a png, pdf a jpg, exporta las páginas como imágenes, saca una foto de cada página

file.description: PDF: absolute path or document id (d_…).
file.title: File

password.description: Password of the PDF if it is protected.
password.title: Password

out_dir.description: Absolute folder. Default: a new folder «<name>_imagenes» next to the source.
out_dir.title: Out Dir

schema.name: images_compress
schema.description:
Compress PNG, JPEG and WEBP images under a size limit, single or folder. Comprimir imágenes.
Copies, never touches the originals: lossless first, then fewer colours or lower quality, then smaller size. lossless_only reports what cannot fit. A folder goes to «<folder>_comprimidas»; a file to «<name>_comprimida».
Sinónimos: comprime las imágenes, que cada png pese menos de 5 MB, reduce el tamaño de las fotos, las fotos pesan mucho, optimiza los png

sources.description: Image files (PNG, JPEG, WEBP), document ids or folders: absolute paths.
sources.title: Sources

limit_mb.description: Maximum size of each image in MB (1 MB = 1024 KB).
limit_mb.title: Limit Mb

limit_kb.description: Maximum size of each image in KB (use this or limit_mb).
limit_kb.title: Limit Kb

lossless_only.description: Never lower quality or size: images that stay above the limit are reported as failed.
lossless_only.title: Lossless Only

skip_small.description: Leave images already under the limit alone (not copied).
skip_small.title: Skip Small

out_dir.description: Absolute output folder. Default: «<folder>_comprimidas» next to a folder, or «<name>_comprimida» next to a file. An existing file there is skipped.
out_dir.title: Out Dir

time_limit_s.description: Stop after this many seconds and say what is left (0: no limit); repeat with the same out_dir to continue.
time_limit_s.title: Time Limit S

schema.name: doc_extract
schema.description:
Text of a file, scans too: PDF, image, Office, html, eml. Leer un documento, con OCR si es escaneo.
Stateless: nothing is filed in Kafka. Returns kind, title, text, units (page, section, slide, sheet), needs_ocr, notes and pages_ocr; pages without a text layer are read with OCR (ocr=auto|off|force). A long scan answers a job_id: follow it with ocr_status.
Sinónimos: extrae el texto, lee este pdf escaneado, OCR, leer una foto de un documento, texto de un word, contenido del fichero

path.description: Absolute path of the file to read: PDF, image, docx, odt, pptx, xlsx, epub, rtf, html, eml or text.
path.title: Path

ocr.description: auto: OCR only the pages without a text layer. off: never. force: every page.
ocr.title: Ocr

max_pages.description: Read at most this many pages.
max_pages.title: Max Pages

lang.description: Language of the text for OCR (es, en, fr, pt, it, de, ca).
lang.title: Lang

wait_s.description: Wait up to this many seconds (clamped to 150) for the result; past it the answer is the running job (job_id, status): follow it with ocr_status.
wait_s.title: Wait S

schema.name: ocr_image
schema.description:
OCR of one image: its text, and the lines with boxes on request. Leer el texto de una imagen.
Spanish by default. 503 ocr_unavailable (with an install hint) when no engine is installed.
Sinónimos: reconocer texto, captura de pantalla, foto de un ticket, texto de una imagen, OCR

path.description: Absolute path of the image (PNG, JPEG, WEBP, HEIC, BMP, TIFF, GIF).
path.title: Path

lang.description: Language of the text (es, en, fr, pt, it, de, ca).
lang.title: Lang

blocks.description: Also return every recognised line with its box and confidence.
blocks.title: Blocks

schema.name: ocr_pdf
schema.description:
OCR of the pages of a PDF, without its text layer. Reconocer el texto de un PDF escaneado.
Runs as a job: wait_s up to 150 s, then the running job comes back; follow it with ocr_status. pages is e.g. '1-5,9'.
Sinónimos: pdf escaneado, ocr de las páginas, texto de un escaneo, reconocimiento de texto

path.description: Absolute path of the PDF.
path.title: Path

pages.description: Pages to recognise, e.g. '1-5,9' (default: the first max_pages).
pages.title: Pages

dpi.description: Resolution the pages are rendered at before OCR.
dpi.title: Dpi

lang.description: Language of the text (es, en, fr, pt, it, de, ca).
lang.title: Lang

max_pages.description: Recognise at most this many pages.
max_pages.title: Max Pages

wait_s.description: Wait up to this many seconds (clamped to 150); past it the answer is the running job.
wait_s.title: Wait S

schema.name: ocr_status
schema.description:
The OCR engine, or a doc_extract / ocr_pdf job. Estado del OCR y de sus trabajos.
Without job_id: {available, backend, languages, reason?}. With a job_id: that job, waiting up to wait_s (max 150 s) for it to finish.
Sinónimos: motor de OCR, ¿hay OCR instalado?, seguir un trabajo, cómo va el escaneo

job_id.description: A doc_extract or ocr_pdf job. Empty: report the OCR engine instead.
job_id.title: Job Id

wait_s.description: With a job_id: wait up to this many seconds (clamped to 150) for it to finish.
wait_s.title: Wait S
